scripts.text:
[Sunglasses Trader]
There is nothing more I can tell you.

[Sunglasses Trader]
Hello. What can I do for you?

[Sunglasses Trader]
Go see Maseph. She is somewhere north of Morocc.
I heard that you can make ^0000FFSlotted Sunglasses^000000.
Nothing, sorry to bother you.

[Sunglasses Trader]
Come back to me than you are ready.

[Sunglasses Trader]
I do not make them, but I can tell you where to find the person who does. For a small fee...
How much?
No way, I will find her myself!

[Sunglasses Trader]
Suit yourself, the Maker will not make you ^0000FFSlotted Sunglasses^000000 unless she knows that you are coming.
Only I can tell her you are coming.

[Sunglasses Trader]
Come back to me when you have given up. Hahaha...

[Sunglasses Trader]
In order for me to tell you information on ^0000FFSlotted Sunglasses^000000 you need to get me:
 - ^0000881 Carat Diamond^000000
 - ^00008850 Feathers^000000
 - ^000088100000z^000000
Alright, here.
That's too much!

[Sunglasses Trader]
Suit yourself.

[Sunglasses Trader]
You're missing something. Come back when you've gathered all the materials.

[Sunglasses Trader]
[Sunglasses Trader]
Great. Now, listen carefully.

[Sunglasses Trader]
Look for someone named Maseph somewhere north of Morocc.
I will send her a message to let her know that you are coming.

[Maseph]
Lovely day, isn't it ?

[Maseph]
Hello there.
You came for the ^000088Slotted Sunglasses^000000, right?
Yes
No, sorry to bother you.

[Maseph]
Off you go, then.

[Maseph]
To make one, I will need one pair of ^000088Sunglasses^000000 and 400000z.
Here you go.
No, thanks.

[Maseph]
As you wish.

[Maseph]
I need one pair of ^000088Sunglasses^000000. Come back to me when you have one.

[Maseph]
You do not have enough Zeny. Come back to me when you do.

[Maseph]
Thank you. I will get on it right away...

[Maseph]
Here you go, my friend.
Enjoy your ^000088Slotted Sunglasses^000000.
